info.name: Get phone number details from Twilio

params.name: phoneNumber
params.description: The phone number to lookup (E.164 format, e.g., +1234567890)

params.name: force
params.description: Force a fresh lookup from Twilio API even if cached data exists

items.docs: Retrieves phone number caller name information from Twilio API. Results are cached in the database. Use the force parameter to bypass cache and fetch fresh data.
